title: natural-order rename + '--- /dev/null' splits into rename + create (E600)
notes: The pair /dev/null,b.txt does not have `from` as its `---` path, so it starts a create block (§4.1; §12 item 1 and the §6.4.2 parenthetical: 'a rename followed by a create, not E604'); after the in-memory rename b.txt exists -> E600.
